```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

HST <- -0.02

a3v <- c(
  A=-0.036,R=-1.240,N=-1.302,D=-1.836,C=0.604,Q=-1.231,E=-1.412,
  G=-0.535,H=-1.033,I=1.822,L=1.380,K=-0.931,M=0.910,F=1.754,
  P=-0.334,S=-0.294,T=-0.159,W=1.037,Y=1.159,V=1.594
)

clean_id <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- stringr::str_remove(x, "^>")
  x <- dplyr::if_else(
    stringr::str_detect(x, "\\|"),
    stringr::str_split_fixed(x, "\\|", 3)[, 2],
    x
  )
  x <- stringr::str_remove(x, ";.*$")
  stringr::str_remove(x, "-\\d+$")
}

clean_seq <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_replace_all(
    toupper(x),
    "[^ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]",
    ""
  )
}

window_size <- function(n) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    n <= 75  ~ 5L,
    n <= 175 ~ 7L,
    n <= 300 ~ 9L,
    TRUE     ~ 11L
  )
}

profile <- function(seq) {

  aa <- strsplit(clean_seq(seq), "")[[1]]
  vals <- unname(a3v[aa])
  n <- length(vals)
  w <- window_size(n)

  ext <- c(
    mean(a3v[c("D", "E")]),
    vals,
    mean(a3v[c("K", "R")])
  )

  starts <- seq_len(length(ext) - w + 1)
  centers <- starts + floor(w / 2) - 1

  raw <- purrr::map_dbl(
    starts,
    \(i) mean(ext[i:(i + w - 1)])
  )

  out <- rep(NA_real_, n)

  keep <- centers >= 1 & centers <= n
  out[centers[keep]] <- raw[keep]

  first <- min(which(!is.na(out)))
  last <- max(which(!is.na(out)))

  if (first > 1) {
    out[1:(first - 1)] <- out[first]
  }

  if (last < n) {
    out[(last + 1):n] <- out[last]
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    AA = aa,
    a3v = vals,
    a4v = out
  )
}

hotspots <- function(p) {

  mask <- is.finite(p$a4v) &
    p$a4v > HST &
    p$AA != "P"

  r <- rle(mask)

  ends <- cumsum(r$lengths)
  starts <- ends - r$lengths + 1
  runs <- which(r$values & r$lengths >= 5)

  purrr::map_dfr(
    runs,
    \(i) {
      idx <- starts[i]:ends[i]

      tibble::tibble(
        HS_Start = min(idx),
        HS_End = max(idx),
        HSA = sum(p$a4v[idx] - HST)
      )
    }
  )
}

aggrescan <- function(seq) {

  p <- profile(seq)
  hs <- hotspots(p)

  n <- nrow(p)
  a4vSS <- sum(p$a4v)

  tibble::tibble(
    Sequence_Length = n,
    AGGRESCAN_Window = window_size(n),
    a3vSA = mean(p$a3v),
    nHS = nrow(hs),
    NnHS = nrow(hs) / n * 100,
    AAT = sum(
      dplyr::if_else(
        p$AA != "P",
        pmax(p$a4v - HST, 0),
        0
      )
    ),
    THSA = sum(hs$HSA),
    a4vSS = a4vSS,
    Na4vSS = a4vSS / n * 100,
    Hotspots = if (nrow(hs) > 0) {
      paste0(
        hs$HS_Start,
        "-",
        hs$HS_End,
        collapse = "; "
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Parse master FASTA
# ============================================================

fasta_entries <- stringr::str_split(
  master_fasta,
  "(?m)(?=^>)"
)[[1]]

fasta_entries <- fasta_entries[
  stringr::str_starts(
    stringr::str_trim(fasta_entries),
    ">"
  )
]

uniprot_sequences <- tibble::tibble(
  FASTA = fasta_entries
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Header = purrr::map_chr(
      FASTA,
      \(x) stringr::str_split(x, "\n")[[1]][1]
    ),
    Protein_ID = clean_id(Header),
    Sequence = purrr::map_chr(
      FASTA,
      \(x) {
        lines <- stringr::str_split(x, "\n")[[1]]

        lines[!stringr::str_starts(lines, ">")] %>%
          paste0(collapse = "") %>%
          clean_seq()
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Protein_ID != "",
    Sequence != ""
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Protein_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Protein_ID,
    Sequence
  )

# ============================================================
# Run AGGRESCAN on every retrieved protein
# ============================================================

aggrescan_metrics <- uniprot_sequences %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metrics = purrr::map(
      Sequence,
      aggrescan
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(metrics) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Sequence)

# ============================================================
# Map proteins back to all qualifying groups
# ============================================================

protein_groups <- detection_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    N_detected >= min_detected
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Group,
    Protein.Group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(
    Protein.Group,
    delim = ";"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Group,
    Protein_ID = stringr::str_trim(Protein.Group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Protein_ID != "",
    !stringr::str_detect(
      Protein_ID,
      stringr::regex(
        "^cRAP-",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Protein_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Groups = paste(
      sort(unique(Group)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# Final master AGGRESCAN table
# ============================================================

all_aggrescan <- protein_groups %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    aggrescan_metrics,
    by = "Protein_ID"
  )

missing_aggrescan <- all_aggrescan %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(a4vSS)
  )

cat(
  "Proteins:", nrow(all_aggrescan),
  "\nFASTA sequences:", nrow(uniprot_sequences),
  "\nScored:", sum(!is.na(all_aggrescan$a4vSS)),
  "\nMissing:", nrow(missing_aggrescan),
  "\n"
)

missing_aggrescan
```
